title: How do you actually combine two games?
author: unknow67172571
selftext: How do you actually combine two games like in those videos i only know it requires a decompile and claude or something? If anyone could explain it to me i would be so thankful!

comments.author: robhanz
comments.body: Until proven otherwise, I suspect those are just video gen.

replies.author: Ohgood9002
replies.body:
There is a tremendous amount of documentation on how to do this. 

....i think maybe the issue is you arent doing your own research on it and just going "hurr durr must be fake"

replies.author: Bluetails_Buizel
replies.body: I could install replaymod on the Minecraft side and pretend to say that it is still fake.

comments.author: Catapultam-GMG
comments.body: its passthrough modding. both games are running, memory is being read in both to do state coherence and render outputs are combined. It is wildly impractical to make a meaningful mod that does something other than make amusing videos.

replies.author: Ohgood9002
replies.body: At least for a couple weeks.

replies.author: Catapultam-GMG
replies.body: Conceptually it is a dead end because it requires both games to be running etc. Also these type of mods are just fucking dumb.

replies.author: Ohgood9002
replies.body: Again, for now. 2 weeks ago this wasnt a thjng. A year ago the guantlet loop wasnt a thing. 5 years ago dalle couldn't even generate an image correctly

replies.author: Catapultam-GMG
replies.body: You are misunderstanding me. I'm not saying doing it in a way that isn't useless is impossible or won't happen. I'm saying it will be a totally different strategy. (I'm also saying that the basic concept of 'minecraft in Skyrim' or whatever is just a dumb gimmick that wouldn't be fun gameplay, but a mashup of the mechanics in a way that made sense instead of just being a fancy render overlay might be)

replies.author: SoonBlossom
replies.body:
It's still incredibly cool imo

I don't care if the tech behind it is janky, being able to play Dante in Elden Ring or Steve in Skyrim and placing traps and TNT has no price

It's like a childhood dream becoming true
